prompt:
Task / size class:
BWJ-3 / Loop 108 — MEDIUM, mock/static Blue Work ↔ J-BLUE round-trip integration proof.

Goal:
Prove the BWJ-3 roadmap flow entirely with existing pure helpers and fixture-only tests. Do not add a new production orchestrator or generic framework. The preferred implementation is one integration test file that composes the existing BWJ-1 classifier, BWJ-2 prepare-only Blue wake builder, current pure Controller/Jules preparation helpers, and mock receipt fixtures. No GitHub/Work/Jules/provider/model live execution is allowed.

Read first:
- docs/BLUE_WORK_JULES_WEBHOOK_LOOP_ROADMAP.md (BWJ-3 only; do not implement BWJ-4+)
- automation/command_bus/blue_jules_result_event.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_jules_result_event.py
- automation/command_bus/blue_work_wake_prepare.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_work_wake_prepare.py
- automation/command_bus/claude_loop.py, specifically BackendMode, VerdictDecision, make_structured_verdict, prepare_next_action, prepare_jules_semiauto_request
- automation/command_bus/jules_api_request.py validate_request
- automation/command_bus/event_processor.py terminal-receipt replay idea
- current Blue carrier protocol on branch cloud-work/carrier-blue-v1 as protocol reference only

Allowed changed paths only:
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_work_jules_webhook_static_e2e.py

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- add exactly the one allowed test file; do not modify production code in this mission
- no workflow/schema/docs/dependency/config/lockfile changes
- no GitHub API/client/network/filesystem write
- no PR review/comment submission
- no real Cloud Work wake
- no worker state/generation mutation
- no Jules claim/command/session creation outside this already-authorized task transport itself
- the test must not dispatch Jules or persist a jules_api_request
- no provider/model/API execution
- no webhook server/listener/poller/queue/database/scheduler/dashboard/framework
- no BWJ-4 or later behavior
- no Merge/rebase/force push/branch deletion/default-branch write
- retry=0; fallback=disabled

Reuse-first:
- Reuse classify_blue_jules_result_event / EventLineage / EventDecision.
- Reuse prepare_blue_work_wake / CarrierSnapshot / TargetSnapshot.
- Reuse make_structured_verdict, prepare_next_action, and prepare_jules_semiauto_request from claude_loop.py for the mock Controller -> next Jules prepare-only leg.
- Reuse jules_api_request.validate_request to validate the unpersisted next-Jules request.
- Do not add a second dispatcher, a second command schema, a new durable ledger, or a production receipt parser solely for this test.
- A tiny private test-only fixture/helper for simulating Blue worker generation fencing or a mock receipt is allowed only when no repository production helper exists. Keep it visibly test-only and deterministic.

Required fixture flow:
mock Jules PR opened event
→ BWJ-1 classifier
→ BWJ-2 prepare-only Blue wake command
→ parse the prepared [CW_BLUE_V1] JSON
→ mock Blue Work terminal receipt
→ mock Controller PASS/CONTINUE next-task decision
→ existing prepare_next_action
→ existing prepare_jules_semiauto_request
→ jules_api_request.validate_request on the unpersisted next-Jules request
→ mock a new result HEAD/event
→ replay the original event as a duplicate

Required semantics / direct assertions:
1. First matching result event returns WAKE and deterministic identity blue-jules-result-pr<PR>-<FULL_HEAD_SHA>.
2. BWJ-2 returns PREPARED, review body line 1 is exactly [CW_BLUE_V1], JSON parses, worker_generation is the fixture's current active generation, exact result PR/branch/head are bound, retry=0, fallback=disabled, live_provider_or_model_allowed=false, allowed_paths=[].
3. Mock Blue worker generation fence must model the current carrier protocol: fixed WORKER_GENERATION, worker-state active_generation, and command.worker_generation must all match to proceed. Any mismatch fails closed (STALE/NO_OP-like test outcome) and never reaches next-Jules preparation. This may be a tiny test-only pure helper because the Cloud Work runtime itself is external to this repo.
4. Mock terminal receipt must be bound to the exact command_id, worker_generation, target repo/PR/branch/head and terminal=true. PASS is the success fixture; malformed/mismatched receipt must not feed the Controller continuation path.
5. The mock Controller PASS/CONTINUE decision must use make_structured_verdict with BackendMode.JULES_BACKEND and a bounded next_prompt, exact target head/tree, generation/correlation, retry=0, fallback disabled, no live/external send.
6. prepare_next_action must return PREPARED for the clean success fixture with explicit ADD/MODIFY path policy.
7. prepare_jules_semiauto_request must return PREPARED only; validate_request must accept the resulting request at the fixed fixture time. Assert:
   - profile == JULES_CHAT_SEMIAUTO_V2
   - exact target branch/head/tree
   - origin loop/round/correlation/generation preserved
   - retry=0 / fallback=disabled
   - merge_allowed=false / force_push_allowed=false
   - no request was persisted or submitted by the test.
8. One logical result creates at most one Blue command:
   - replay the exact original PR+HEAD with existing command identity -> classifier/BWJ-2 path results in IGNORE/NO_OP and no second review body.
9. A genuinely new result HEAD for the same PR creates a distinct deterministic identity and may PREPARE a distinct Blue review body when current head matches.
10. Stale old-head case:
    - classification identity remains tied to old result head
    - BWJ-2 current_target_head differs
    - result must be STALE with no review body
    - no next-Jules preparation is performed.
11. Worker generation mismatch fails closed before Controller continuation.
12. Terminal receipt replay prevents the next Jules preparation:
    use the existing prepare_next_action existing_terminal_receipts guard with a matching CONSUMED receipt tuple and assert NO-OP.
13. Wrong/malformed mock receipt correlation, generation, target or terminal flag must be rejected by the test-only receipt gate before next-Jules preparation.
14. All fixtures use fixed times; no wall-clock reads required for assertions.
15. No Merge/default write/live provider/model/Jules execution occurs.
16. Tests must be semantic, not name-only/vacuous.

Negative / tamper cases:
- duplicate same event/identity -> no second Blue body
- new HEAD -> new identity/body
- stale current head -> STALE/no body/no next preparation
- command.worker_generation != active_generation -> blocked/static stale
- fixed WORKER_GENERATION != active_generation -> blocked/static stale
- receipt command_id mismatch -> blocked
- receipt generation mismatch -> blocked
- receipt target head mismatch -> blocked
- receipt terminal=false/missing -> blocked
- terminal consumed next-action receipt -> prepare_next_action NO-OP
- generated next-Jules request with exact normal fixture validates; do not weaken validate_request
- no network/file/GitHub mutation mocks should be necessary

Acceptance criteria:
- exact one-file allowed-path fence
- no production implementation changes
- static E2E test exercises actual BWJ-1, BWJ-2, Controller/Jules prepare-only helpers
- direct assertions cover every BWJ-3 roadmap verification:
  one logical result <= one Blue command;
  duplicate NO-OP;
  new head new identity;
  stale head cannot continue;
  worker generation mismatch fails closed;
  terminal receipt prevents replay;
  no Merge/default write/live model
- focused test passes
- full command-bus unittest suite passes
- compileall passes
- git diff --check passes

Exact validation commands:
python -m unittest automation.command_bus.tests.test_blue_work_jules_webhook_static_e2e -v
python -m unittest discover -s automation/command_bus/tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q automation/command_bus
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Only if the exact one-file fence holds and every validation command passes, create the normal Jules result PR from the isolated work branch descendant. Do not Merge. Do not post [CW_BLUE_V1]. Do not create/persist a next Jules command.

Explicit stop conditions:
- a correct proof would require any production-code change
- an existing helper needed by the roadmap cannot be composed without changing its contract
- any GitHub/network/live Work/Jules/provider/model execution would be required
- BWJ-4+ behavior is required
- safety/fail-closed semantics would need weakening
- if one of these is true, make no out-of-scope edit and report BLOCKED with the exact missing primitive
